WITH return_allocations AS(SELECT receipt_item.return_item_id, receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id, SUM(receipt_item.quantity) AS allocated_quantity FROM xsy_order_return_receipt_item receipt_item WHERE receipt_item.bundle_receipt_counted = TRUE GROUP BY receipt_item.return_item_id, receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id), return_allocation_totals AS(SELECT return_item_id, SUM(allocated_quantity) AS allocated_quantity FROM return_allocations GROUP BY return_item_id), independent_allocations AS ( SELECT item.return_item_id, receipt.warehouse_id, SUM(item.quantity) AS quantity FROM xsy_order_return_receipt_item item JOIN xsy_order_return_receipt receipt ON receipt.id = item.receipt_id JOIN xsy_order_return doc ON doc.id = receipt.return_id AND doc.source_type = 'INDEPENDENT' AND doc.deleted = FALSE WHERE item.source_sales_out_movement_id IS NULL AND item.bundle_receipt_counted = TRUE GROUP BY item.return_item_id, receipt.warehouse_id ), independent_revenue AS ( SELECT r.source_id AS return_id, ri.source_id AS return_item_id, r.event_at, ri.amount, item.approved_quantity FROM xsy_finance_receivable r JOIN xsy_finance_receivable_item ri ON ri.receivable_id = r.id AND ri.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN_ITEM' AND ri.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_order_return_item item ON item.id = ri.source_id AND item.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.entry_type = 'RED' AND r.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND r.order_id IS NULL AND r.event_at >= #{startAt} AND r.event_at < #{endAt} ), independent_events AS ( SELECT r.return_id, r.return_item_id, a.warehouse_id, r.event_at, -r.amount * a.quantity / NULLIF(r.approved_quantity, 0) AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM independent_revenue r JOIN independent_allocations a ON a.return_item_id = r.return_item_id UNION ALL SELECT r.return_id, r.return_item_id, NULL::BIGINT, r.event_at, -r.amount * GREATEST(r.approved_quantity - COALESCE(a.quantity, 0), 0) / NULLIF(r.approved_quantity, 0), 0::NUMERIC, 0::BIGINT FROM independent_revenue r LEFT JOIN (SELECT return_item_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM independent_allocations GROUP BY return_item_id) a ON a.return_item_id = r.return_item_id WHERE r.approved_quantity > COALESCE(a.quantity, 0) UNION ALL SELECT receipt.return_id, item.return_item_id, receipt.warehouse_id, receipt.received_at, 0::NUMERIC, -COALESCE(item.stock_quantity, item.quantity) * item.unit_cost, CASE WHEN item.unit_cost IS NULL THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END FROM xsy_order_return_receipt receipt JOIN xsy_order_return_receipt_item item ON item.receipt_id = receipt.id JOIN xsy_order_return doc ON doc.id = receipt.return_id AND doc.source_type = 'INDEPENDENT' AND doc.deleted = FALSE WHERE item.source_sales_out_movement_id IS NULL AND receipt.received_at >= #{startAt} AND receipt.received_at < #{endAt} ), facts AS( -- Revenue is recognized from NORMAL Finance receivables at their event time. SELECT
, receivable_item.amount AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_order_bundle_component bc WHERE bc.order_item_id = soi.id) THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_order_bundle_component bc WHERE bc.order_item_id = soi.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item child JOIN xsy_inventory_movement movement ON movement.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND movement.source_document_item_id = child.id AND movement.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND movement.deleted = FALSE WHERE child.outbound_id = outbound_item.outbound_id AND child.bundle_component_id = bc.id AND child.deleted = FALSE AND
)) THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END ELSE CASE WHEN sales_out.id IS NULL OR NOT (
) THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END END AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_finance_receivable receivable JOIN xsy_finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'INVENTORY_OUTBOUND_ITEM' JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound outbound ON outbound.id = outbound_item.outbound_id AND outbound.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = receivable_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_inventory_movement sales_out ON sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND sales_out.source_document_item_id = outbound_item.id AND sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND sales_out.warehouse_id = outbound.warehouse_id AND sales_out.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = outbound.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND receivable.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id
UNION ALL -- Approved red receivables reverse revenue. Allocate it only across physically received -- quantities with a traceable original outbound; the not-yet-received remainder is -- unassigned to a xsy_warehouse and is visible only to an all-xsy_warehouse scope. SELECT
, -receivable_item.amount * allocation.allocated_quantity / NULLIF(return_item.approved_quantity, 0) AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_finance_receivable receivable JOIN xsy_finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN_ITEM' JOIN xsy_order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN return_allocations allocation ON allocation.return_item_id = return_item.id JOIN xsy_inventory_movement source_sales_out ON source_sales_out.id = allocation.source_sales_out_movement_id AND source_sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND source_sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND source_sales_out.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = source_sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = source_sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'RED' AND receivable.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id
UNION ALL -- Red revenue that has not yet been physically allocated to a source outbound. SELECT
, -receivable_item.amount * CASE WHEN return_item.approved_quantity > 0 THEN GREATEST( return_item.approved_quantity - COALESCE(allocation_totals.allocated_quantity, 0), 0) / return_item.approved_quantity ELSE 1 END AS revenue_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_finance_receivable receivable JOIN xsy_finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN_ITEM' JOIN xsy_order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receivable_item.source_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN return_allocation_totals allocation_totals ON allocation_totals.return_item_id = return_item.id JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = receivable.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT receivable.event_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON FALSE
WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'RED' AND receivable.source_type = 'ORDER_RETURN' AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt} AND (return_item.approved_quantity IS NULL OR return_item.approved_quantity > COALESCE(allocation_totals.allocated_quantity, 0))
AND FALSE

, 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, COALESCE(sales_out.quantity * sales_out.unit_cost, 0) AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, CASE WHEN NOT ( ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_finance_receivable receivable JOIN xsy_finance_receivable_item receivable_item ON receivable_item.receivable_id = receivable.id AND receivable_item.deleted = FALSE AND receivable_item.source_type = 'INVENTORY_OUTBOUND_ITEM' WHERE receivable.deleted = FALSE AND receivable.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND receivable.source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND receivable_item.source_id = outbound_item.id AND receivable.event_at >= #{startAt} AND receivable.event_at < #{endAt}) THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_inventory_movement sales_out JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE AND outbound_item.sales_order_id IS NOT NULL AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id IS NOT NULL JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound outbound ON outbound.id = outbound_item.outbound_id AND outbound.deleted = FALSE AND outbound.warehouse_id = sales_out.warehouse_id JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = outbound_item.sales_order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = outbound_item.sales_order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sales_out.occurred_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE sales_out.deleted = FALSE AND sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND sales_out.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND sales_out.occurred_at < #{endAt}
UNION ALL -- Physical acceptance reverses original sales cost; disposition only -- decides whether the returned quantity becomes available inventory. SELECT
, 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, - (COALESCE(receipt_item.stock_quantity, receipt_item.quantity) * receipt_item.unit_cost) AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_order_return_receipt_item receipt_item JOIN xsy_order_return_receipt return_receipt ON return_receipt.id = receipt_item.receipt_id JOIN xsy_order_return return_doc ON return_doc.id = return_receipt.return_id JOIN xsy_order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = receipt_item.return_item_id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_inventory_movement source_sales_out ON source_sales_out.id = receipt_item.source_sales_out_movement_id AND source_sales_out.source_document_type = 'SALES_OUTBOUND_ITEM' AND source_sales_out.movement_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND source_sales_out.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_inventory_outbound_item outbound_item ON outbound_item.id = source_sales_out.source_document_item_id AND outbound_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = return_doc.order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_sales_order_item soi ON soi.id = return_item.order_item_id AND soi.deleted = FALSE CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT return_receipt.received_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = source_sales_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE return_receipt.received_at >= #{startAt} AND return_receipt.received_at < #{endAt} AND outbound_item.sales_order_item_id = soi.id AND outbound_item.sales_order_id = so.id

) THEN 1::BIGINT ELSE 0::BIGINT END AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_inventory_movement gift_out JOIN xsy_order_promotion_gift gift ON gift.id = gift_out.source_document_item_id JOIN xsy_sales_order so ON so.id = gift.sales_order_id AND so.deleted = FALSE JOIN (SELECT sku.id AS id, sku.id AS sku_id, spu.id AS spu_id, spu.spu_code AS spu_code_snapshot, spu.name AS product_name_snapshot, sku.sku_code AS sku_code_snapshot FROM xsy_product_sku sku JOIN xsy_product_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id) soi ON soi.id = gift.sku_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT gift_out.occurred_at AS event_at) fact_event LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = gift_out.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE
WHERE gift_out.deleted = FALSE AND gift_out.source_document_type = 'ORDER_PROMOTION_GIFT' AND gift_out.movement_type = 'PROMOTION_GIFT_OUT' AND gift_out.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND gift_out.occurred_at < #{endAt}
UNION ALL SELECT , return_event.revenue_amount, return_event.sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, return_event.cost_missing_count FROM independent_events return_event JOIN xsy_order_return return_doc ON return_doc.id = return_event.return_id AND return_doc.source_type = 'INDEPENDENT' AND return_doc.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_order_return_item return_item ON return_item.id = return_event.return_item_id AND return_item.return_id = return_doc.id AND return_item.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = return_doc.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = c.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku sku ON sku.id = return_item.sku_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu ps ON ps.id = sku.spu_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat ON cat.id = ps.category_id AND cat.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat2 ON cat2.id = cat.parent_id AND cat2.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat3 ON cat3.id = cat2.parent_id AND cat3.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = return_event.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE WHERE TRUE
UNION ALL SELECT CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN adjustment.sku_id WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN cat.id WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN w.id ELSE NULL::BIGINT END AS dimension_id, CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN adjustment.product_name_snapshot WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN COALESCE(cat.name, '未分类') WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN w.name WHEN 'DAY' THEN TO_CHAR((adjustment.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '未分摊采购价差' END AS dimension_name, CASE #{query.dimension} WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN sku.sku_code WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN CAST(cat.id AS VARCHAR) WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN w.warehouse_code ELSE NULL::VARCHAR END AS dimension_code, CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} = 'DAY' THEN (adjustment.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date ELSE NULL::DATE END AS biz_date, 0::NUMERIC AS revenue_amount, CASE WHEN adjustment.direction = 'INCREASE' THEN adjustment.amount ELSE -adjustment.amount END AS sales_cost_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS gift_cost_amount, 0::BIGINT AS cost_missing_count FROM xsy_purchase_cost_adjustment adjustment JOIN xsy_purchase_order po ON po.id = adjustment.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = adjustment.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku sku ON sku.id = adjustment.sku_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu ps ON ps.id = sku.spu_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat ON cat.id = ps.category_id AND cat.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat2 ON cat2.id = cat.parent_id AND cat2.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_category cat3 ON cat3.id = cat2.parent_id AND cat3.deleted = FALSE WHERE adjustment.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND adjustment.occurred_at < #{endAt}
AND FALSE
AND po.purchaser_id IN #{id}

AND FALSE AND w.id = #{query.warehouseId} AND adjustment.sku_id = #{query.skuId}
AND (cat.id = #{query.categoryId} OR cat2.id = #{query.categoryId} OR cat3.id = #{query.categoryId})
AND (adjustment.adjustment_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR adjustment.product_name_snapshot ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
)
mapper.select: SELECT dimension_id AS dimensionId, MAX(dimension_name) AS dimensionName, MAX(dimension_code) AS dimensionCode, biz_date AS bizDate, COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS revenueAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) AS salesCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) AS giftCostAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) END AS grossProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount)) / NULLIF( SUM(revenue_amount), 0) * 100, 4) END AS grossMarginRate, SUM(cost_missing_count) AS costMissingCount FROM facts GROUP BY dimension_id, biz_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} = 'DAY' THEN biz_date END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN #{query.dimension} <> 'DAY' THEN CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM (revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount) END END DESC NULLS LAST, SUM(revenue_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, MAX(dimension_name)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS revenueAmount, COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) AS salesCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) AS giftCostAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) END AS grossProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(revenue_amount) - SUM(sales_cost_amount) - SUM(gift_cost_amount)) / NULLIF( SUM(revenue_amount), 0) * 100, 4) END AS grossMarginRate, COALESCE(SUM(cost_missing_count), 0) AS costMissingCount FROM facts
SELECT * FROM monthly_rows ORDER BY net_profit DESC NULLS LAST, dimension_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS revenue_amount, COALESCE(SUM(sales_cost_amount), 0) AS sales_cost_amount, COALESCE(SUM(gift_cost_amount), 0) AS gift_cost_amount, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS tax_amount, COALESCE(SUM(service_amount), 0) AS service_amount, COALESCE(SUM(freight_amount), 0) AS freight_amount, COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) AS commission_amount, COALESCE(SUM(expense_amount), 0) AS expense_amount, COALESCE(SUM(cost_missing_count), 0) AS cost_missing_count, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(gross_profit), 0) END AS gross_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(cost_missing_count) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(net_profit), 0) END AS net_profit FROM monthly_rows
